description: This Python script generates a Monthly TDS Payable Report for a specific accounting software (likely Frappe/ERPNext). It includes functions to validate filters, fetch data related to TDS deductions, suppliers, GST ledger entries, and generate report columns dynamically. The core logic involves aggregating TDS deducted amounts per supplier and tax category, and formatting the results for report output.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main function that validates filters, retrieves TDS documents, and returns assembled report columns and data.

methods.name: validate_filters(filters)
methods.description: Checks if the provided date filters are logical (from_date not after to_date).

methods.name: get_result(filters, tds_docs, tds_accounts, tax_category_map)
methods.description: Processes ledger entries to generate TDS deducted details per supplier within the specified filters.

methods.name: get_supplier_pan_map()
methods.description: Fetches supplier details including PAN, name, and tax categories, creating a mapping for quick lookup.

methods.name: get_gle_map(filters, documents)
methods.description: Creates a mapping of voucher numbers to related GL entries for further processing.

methods.name: get_columns(filters)
methods.description: Dynamically constructs the report's column definitions based on the filters and database schema.

methods.name: get_tds_docs(filters)
methods.description: Retrieves TDS-related documents within date range and optional supplier filter, categorizing vouchers by type.

methods.name: get_tax_category_map(vouchers, doctype, tax_category_map)
methods.description: Creates a mapping of voucher IDs to their respective tax withholding categories.

methods.name: get_tax_rate_map(filters)
methods.description: Fetches applicable tax withholding rates for the given date range.
